recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. If this recurs, investigate the publisher artifact-generation/deployment pipeline rather than changing downloads.html wording.
issue_request: FHIR-13221 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core downloads issue reporting that http://hl7.org/fhir/fhir-codegen-xsd.zip had not been fully regenerated: fhir-all.xsd still identified FHIR v0.5.0 and missed many resources.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-13221 was found. The Jira comment records the actual application: the out-of-sync file was corrected on the web site by FTP.
additional_context: The repository tracks the downloads page and schema explanatory text, while schema/codegen and schema XSD outputs are generated/ignored. A later no-change Jira, FHIR-32662, confirms code generation schemas are expected download artifacts for future versions. The current public ZIP is available and contains fhir-all.xsd generated for FHIR v5.0.0.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The issue concerned a stale generated/published ZIP, not incorrect current source, and the current published artifact no longer exhibits the stale FHIR v0.5.0 content.

related_jiras.note: Later no-change question confirms code generation schemas are expected download artifacts, but it did not request a stale-ZIP source repair.
Earlier published decimal precision issue explains part of the current code-generation schema notes but is not the stale ZIP problem.
Search hit for a different historical schema-breakage issue about Coverage schemas; not part of this reconciliation.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 downloads issue reporting that fhir-codegen-xsd.zip contained an old FHIR v0.5.0 fhir-all.xsd and omitted many resources; the comment says the correct file was FTPed to the web site.
evidence_items.learned: The final applied action was correction of a published generated ZIP, not a tracked source edit.

evidence_items.summary: The current downloads page links to fhir-codegen-xsd.zip and the XML page describes the code generation schema download.
evidence_items.learned: The current source-facing documentation is coherent and does not contain the stale 2015 generated schema content.

evidence_items.locator: git history and generated schema source checks
evidence_items.command: git log --all --grep='FHIR-13221|13221|Code Generation Schemas|fhir-codegen-xsd'; git ls-files '*fhir-codegen-xsd*' '*codegen*'; sed -n '1,20p' .gitignore
evidence_items.summary: No FHIR-13221 source commit was found; schema/codegen is ignored/generated and only a placeholder is tracked.
evidence_items.learned: The broken ZIP contents were not normal checked-in source, matching Jira's web-site FTP fix note.

evidence_items.summary: Resolved - No Change question on code generation schema availability says future versions are expected to provide them, while expectations could evolve, and they do not enforce IG constraints.
evidence_items.learned: Later Jira context supports leaving the current download link in place and does not require a source change for FHIR-13221.

evidence_items.command: curl -fsSIL https://hl7.org/fhir/fhir-codegen-xsd.zip; curl -fsSL https://hl7.org/fhir/fhir-codegen-xsd.zip -o /tmp/fhir-codegen-xsd.zip; unzip -p /tmp/fhir-codegen-xsd.zip fhir-all.xsd | grep -E 'Generated on|xs:include' | head
evidence_items.summary: The current public ZIP returns HTTP 200 and its fhir-all.xsd says it was generated for FHIR v5.0.0 with resource includes.
evidence_items.learned: The current publication surface no longer exhibits the stale FHIR v0.5.0 artifact described by the issue.

evidence_items.locator: Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-13221 and code generation schema terms
evidence_items.command: bun run zulip:search fts '"FHIR-13221"' --limit 10; bun run zulip:search fts '"fhir-codegen-xsd"' --limit 10; bun run zulip:search fts '"Code Generation Schemas"' --limit 10; bun run confluence:search refs jira FHIR-13221; bun run confluence:search fts '"Code Generation Schemas"' --limit 10
evidence_items.summary: No substantive conflicting community record was found; Zulip hits were a Jira bot notification and unrelated implementation questions, and Confluence had no relevant hits.
evidence_items.learned: No discovered community evidence changes the Jira/source conclusion.
